intro: Hezrul's Head is the grisly trophy taken from Hezrul Bloodmark, chieftain of the Kolkar centaur dwelling in the Barrens. Brought to Regthar Deathgate west of the Crossroads, it serves as undeniable proof that the central leadership of the local marauders has fallen.

p: The Kolkar centaur maintain an aggressive hold on the crucial oases throughout the arid Barrens, constantly threatening Horde supply routes and fledgling settlements. Hezrul Bloodmark directs his clan from the Lushwater Oasis to the south. Regthar Deathgate, an orc veteran tasked with securing the territory west of the Crossroads, recognizes that while the Kolkar possess fierce rage, they lack formal discipline. By demanding Hezrul's severed head, Regthar seeks to fracture the clan's command structure, plunging their surviving fighters into disarray and blunting their coordinated assaults against the Horde.
